Test Methodology: For each GPIO pin: set input mode + level_sel=1 (0x00180000); enable group interrupt; trigger via SRAM write; verify IRQ fires; check raw status bit; check group status; clear interrupt; verify clear
Preconditions: GIC IRQ 87 enabled (GPIO0); MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1 set with gpio0_intr bit enabled
Test Steps: 1. Enable GIC IRQ 87; 2. Write LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1_GPIO0_INTR to MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1; 3. For i=0..31: Write 0x00180000 to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4); Write (1<<i) to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1; Write 0xFFFFFFFF to 0xA0243ffc; Wait for IRQ; In ISR: read GPIO reg verify bit1!=0; read INTR_STS1 verify bit i set; write 0x00110000 to clear; verify cleared to 0x100001; disable group intr; verify INTR_STS1==0; clear sysreg RAW_STCR1; verify cleared
Expected Result: IRQ fires for each pin; intr_raw_sts bit set; group interrupt status bit set; interrupt clears successfully; sysreg status clears
Pass/Fail Criteria: PASS if all 32 pins generate and clear interrupts correctly; FAIL if any pin fails
Notes: Tests active-high level interrupt (level_sel=1 at bit 19); Uses GIC IRQ 87 for GPIO0
